webworks.status: Deployed. Common footer live; hero tagline set 2026-11-03. Completed: initial website established, mobile navigation improved, Reflections page featuring 'Coherence: A Quiet Harmony of Being Yourself' with its original RGuytano artwork, archive ready to grow. Remaining work, from Robert's revisions conversation with Charli, supplied verbatim 2026-11-17: (1) establish the identity of RYE Book I ('How to Survive 45', subtitled 'Remembering You're Extraordinary', published on KDP in 2017, given its rightful prominence) and Book II ('Remembering You're Extraordinary', in progress), before expanding commercial material; (2) consolidate the RYE 2.0 material and decide its presentation, distinguishing the book project from individual essays and reflections (not yet finalized); (3) rebuild the content hierarchy around Books, Reflections, and About, with Coherence represented appropriately and the Shop secondary, revisiting homepage, navigation, and destinations; (4) develop the Coherence collection: complete 'Living Coherence: A Gentle Return to Yourself' and introduce it on the site with links to the related Substack reflections and the finished Etsy guide (the three movements How It Feels, What It Looks Like, and The Archetype of Coherence are provisional); (5) integrate the five existing Etsy guides (Reflective Listening Guide, The Kind of Love We Want, Holding Grief Gently, Growing Older Beautifully, When Something No Longer Fits) into the larger RYE ecosystem without the shop dominating the site's identity; (6) continue developing Reflections: feature the newest reflection, move previous entries into The Archive on the MarkhamIdeas.org pattern, and do not duplicate the featured article in the archive.
webworks.next_action: Remaining work awaiting start, named in the status, beginning with the identity of RYE Book I and Book II before expanding commercial material.

Both forwards verified answering publicly on 2026-11-17: remyrmiller.com and rrmeymiller.com each return a permanent redirect to https://rremymiller.com. On 2026-11-18 the Spiral Empire pair footer was deployed on every page of the atelier and in its generator (build.py), the RGuytano page title em dash became a colon ('RGuytano: Art & Music'), and the Remembering You're Extraordinary catalogue entry was aligned with Robert's correction: Book I is 'How to Survive 45' (KDP, 2017), Book II 'Remembering You're Extraordinary' is in progress, with a 'Book I on Amazon' link added on the work's page. The same day, the Remy spiral-rose and RGuytano icons were added to the existing common footer rows on horizontks.com, markhamideas.org, and theryehouse.com.
